name: edugenesis-os
description: EduGenesis OS — zero-cost, AI-first global education, generosity and opportunity infrastructure. Genesis Slice 0 (Phases 0, 1, 5).

scripts.build: tsc -b --force packages/contracts packages/accessibility packages/auth packages/onekey packages/ledger packages/identity packages/verification apps/cli
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/contracts packages/accessibility packages/auth packages/onekey packages/ledger packages/identity packages/verification apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force --pretty false packages/contracts packages/accessibility packages/auth packages/onekey packages/ledger packages/identity packages/verification apps/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:only
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:only && node tools/verify-all.mjs && npm run secrets:scan && npm run sbom && node tools/checksums.mjs && node tools/attest.mjs
